.mx-err{background:#ffebee;border-left:4px solid #c62828;padding:.5rem .7rem;border-radius:5px;color:#8e1616;font-size:.92rem}

.mx-quiz label{display:block;margin:.15rem 0}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// ── Librería de aritmética exacta con fracciones + operaciones matriciales ──
// Todo va dentro de UN solo objeto (Mx) para: (1) permitir funciones
// recursivas, (2) evitar colisiones de nombres entre celdas OJS.
Mx = {
  const gcd = (a, b) => { a = Math.abs(a); b = Math.abs(b); while (b) { const t = a % b; a = b; b = t; } return a || 1; };
  const rat = (n, d = 1) => {
    if (!isFinite(n) || !isFinite(d) || d === 0) return { n: NaN, d: 1 };
    n = Math.round(n); d = Math.round(d);
    if (d < 0) { n = -n; d = -d; }
    const g = gcd(n, d);
    return { n: n / g, d: d / g };
  };
  const add = (a, b) => rat(a.n * b.d + b.n * a.d, a.d * b.d);
  const sub = (a, b) => rat(a.n * b.d - b.n * a.d, a.d * b.d);
  const mul = (a, b) => rat(a.n * b.n, a.d * b.d);
  const div = (a, b) => (b.n === 0 ? { n: NaN, d: 1 } : rat(a.n * b.d, a.d * b.n));
  const neg = a => rat(-a.n, a.d);
  const isZero = a => a.n === 0;
  const eq = (a, b) => a.n === b.n && a.d === b.d;
  const str = a => (Number.isNaN(a.n) ? "?" : (a.d === 1 ? String(a.n) : a.n + "/" + a.d));
  const par = a => (a.n < 0 || a.d !== 1 ? "(" + str(a) + ")" : str(a));
  const val = a => a.n / a.d;
  const dec = (s) => {
    const x = parseFloat(s);
    if (Number.isNaN(x)) return null;
    if (Number.isInteger(x)) return rat(x, 1);
    const dp = (String(s).split(".")[1] || "").length;
    const p = Math.pow(10, dp);
    return rat(Math.round(x * p), p);
  };
  const parseEntry = (s) => {
    const t = String(s).trim();
    if (!/^[+-]?\d+(\.\d+)?(\/[+-]?\d+(\.\d+)?)?$/.test(t)) return null;
    if (t.includes("/")) { const p = t.split("/"); return div(dec(p[0]), dec(p[1])); }
    return dec(t);
  };
  const parseMatrix = (text) => {
    if (!text || !String(text).trim()) return { error: "Escribe una matriz. Ejemplo: 1 2 ; 3 4" };
    const rows = String(text).trim().split(/[;\n]+/).map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r.length > 0);
    const M = [];
    for (const r of rows) {
      const parts = r.split(/[\s,]+/).filter(p => p.length > 0);
      const row = [];
      for (const p of parts) {
        const e = parseEntry(p);
        if (e === null) return { error: 'No entiendo el valor "' + p + '". Usa enteros (-3), decimales con PUNTO (2.5) o fracciones (3/4).' };
        row.push(e);
      }
      if (row.length === 0) return { error: "Hay una fila vacía." };
      M.push(row);
    }
    const c = M[0].length;
    if (M.some(r => r.length !== c)) return { error: "Todas las filas deben tener el mismo número de elementos. Separa filas con ; o con salto de línea." };
    return { M, rows: M.length, cols: c, dim: M.length + "×" + c };
  };
  const zeros = (m, n) => Array.from({ length: m }, () => Array.from({ length: n }, () => rat(0)));
  const ident = (n) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, j) => rat(i === j ? 1 : 0)));
  const clone = A => A.map(r => r.map(x => ({ n: x.n, d: x.d })));
  const addM = (A, B) => A.map((r, i) => r.map((x, j) => add(x, B[i][j])));
  const subM = (A, B) => A.map((r, i) => r.map((x, j) => sub(x, B[i][j])));
  const scaleM = (k, A) => A.map(r => r.map(x => mul(k, x)));
  const mulM = (A, B) => A.map((r) => B[0].map((_, j) => r.reduce((s, x, k) => add(s, mul(x, B[k][j])), rat(0))));
  const trans = A => A[0].map((_, j) => A.map(r => r[j]));
  const powM = (A, p) => { let R = ident(A.length); for (let i = 0; i < p; i++) R = mulM(R, A); return R; };
  const eqM = (A, B) => A.length === B.length && A[0].length === B[0].length && A.every((r, i) => r.every((x, j) => eq(x, B[i][j])));
  const isSquare = A => A.length === A[0].length;
  function minor(A, i, j) { return A.filter((_, r) => r !== i).map(row => row.filter((_, c) => c !== j)); }
  function det(A) {
    const n = A.length;
    if (n === 1) return A[0][0];
    if (n === 2) return sub(mul(A[0][0], A[1][1]), mul(A[0][1], A[1][0]));
    let s = rat(0);
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
      if (isZero(A[0][j])) continue;
      const sg = (j % 2 === 0) ? 1 : -1;
      s = add(s, mul(rat(sg), mul(A[0][j], det(minor(A, 0, j)))));
    }
    return s;
  }
  // Matriz de cofactores (adjuntos) y adjunta traspuesta
  const cofM = A => A.map((r, i) => r.map((_, j) => mul(rat((i + j) % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1), det(minor(A, i, j)))));
  const adjM = A => trans(cofM(A));                       // Adj(A) = (matriz de adjuntos)^t
  const invAdj = A => { const D = det(A); return isZero(D) ? null : scaleM(div(rat(1), D), adjM(A)); };
  // Gauss-Jordan con historial de pasos
  const gaussInv = (A) => {
    const n = A.length;
    const I = ident(n);
    let T = A.map((r, i) => r.concat(I[i]));
    const steps = [{ label: "Matriz ampliada ( A | I )", T: clone(T) }];
    for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) {
      let piv = -1;
      for (let r = c; r < n; r++) if (!isZero(T[r][c])) { piv = r; break; }
      if (piv < 0) return { steps, singular: true };
      if (piv !== c) { const t = T[c]; T[c] = T[piv]; T[piv] = t; steps.push({ label: "F" + (c + 1) + " ↔ F" + (piv + 1), T: clone(T) }); }
      if (!eq(T[c][c], rat(1))) {
        const p = T[c][c];
        T[c] = T[c].map(x => div(x, p));
        steps.push({ label: "F" + (c + 1) + " → F" + (c + 1) + " : " + par(p), T: clone(T) });
      }
      for (let r = 0; r < n; r++) {
        if (r !== c && !isZero(T[r][c])) {
          const f = T[r][c];
          T[r] = T[r].map((x, k) => sub(x, mul(f, T[c][k])));
          steps.push({ label: "F" + (r + 1) + " → F" + (r + 1) + " − " + par(f) + "·F" + (c + 1), T: clone(T) });
        }
      }
    }
    return { steps, singular: false, inv: T.map(r => r.slice(n)) };
  };
  // Escalonamiento por Gauss (rango) con historial
  const rankSteps = (A) => {
    let T = clone(A);
    const m = T.length, n = T[0].length;
    const steps = [{ label: "Matriz de partida", T: clone(T) }];
    let r = 0;
    for (let c = 0; c < n && r < m; c++) {
      let piv = -1;
      for (let i = r; i < m; i++) if (!isZero(T[i][c])) { piv = i; break; }
      if (piv < 0) continue;
      if (piv !== r) { const t = T[r]; T[r] = T[piv]; T[piv] = t; steps.push({ label: "F" + (r + 1) + " ↔ F" + (piv + 1), T: clone(T) }); }
      for (let i = r + 1; i < m; i++) {
        if (!isZero(T[i][c])) {
          const f = div(T[i][c], T[r][c]);
          T[i] = T[i].map((x, k) => sub(x, mul(f, T[r][k])));
          steps.push({ label: "F" + (i + 1) + " → F" + (i + 1) + " − " + par(f) + "·F" + (r + 1), T: clone(T) });
        }
      }
      r++;
    }
    return { steps, rank: r, T };
  };
  // Detalle textual del elemento c_ij de un producto
  const prodDetail = (A, B, i, j) => {
    const terms = A[i].map((x, k) => par(x) + "·" + par(B[k][j]));
    const res = A[i].reduce((s, x, k) => add(s, mul(x, B[k][j])), rat(0));
    return "c" + (i + 1) + (j + 1) + " = " + terms.join(" + ") + " = " + str(res);
  };
  // ── Render ──
  const view = (A, opts) => {
    const o = opts || {};
    return html`<div class="mx-wrap">${o.name ? html`<span class="mx-name">${o.name}</span>` : ""}<span class="mx-br">[</span><table class="mx-tab"><tbody>${A.map((row, i) => html`<tr>${row.map((x, j) => html`<td class=${[
      (o.hi && o.hi[0] === i && o.hi[1] === j) ? "mx-hi" : "",
      (o.hiRow === i) ? "mx-hir" : "",
      (o.hiCol === j) ? "mx-hic" : "",
      (o.divAfter === j) ? "mx-div" : ""
    ].join(" ")}>${str(x)}</td>`)}</tr>`)}</tbody></table><span class="mx-br">]</span></div>`;
  };
  const stepsView = (steps, divAfter) => html`<div>${steps.map(s => html`<div class="mx-step"><span class="lab">${s.label}</span>${view(s.T, { divAfter: divAfter })}</div>`)}</div>`;
  const err = m => html`<div class="mx-err">⚠️ ${m}</div>`;
  const ok = m => html`<div class="mx-ok">✅ ${m}</div>`;
  const info = m => html`<div class="mx-info">💡 ${m}</div>`;
  const decs = (a, k = 4) => (Math.round(val(a) * Math.pow(10, k)) / Math.pow(10, k)).toString();

  return { rat, add, sub, mul, div, neg, isZero, eq, str, par, val, decs,
           parseEntry, parseMatrix, zeros, ident, clone, addM, subM, scaleM, mulM,
           trans, powM, eqM, isSquare, minor, det, cofM, adjM, invAdj,
           gaussInv, rankSteps, prodDetail, view, stepsView, err, ok, info };
}
```
